Choose encryption mode

Select how aggressively to wipe the drive before encrypting it.

Mode
About --shred Adds one full-drive write of cryptographically-random bytes before encryption. Defeats forensic recovery of any prior data and makes unused regions of the encrypted volume look like real ciphertext. On SSD/NVMe, wear-levelling means a single overwrite can't guarantee every physical cell is rewritten — for decommissioning, use hardware secure-erase. (DESIGN.md §4.2)

Recovery key

This is your one chance to save it. We will not show it again.

Save this now. Without the PDF or your passphrase, your data is unrecoverable. There is no backdoor.

Each group is a 16-bit value × 11 (BitLocker-style check digits — see RecoveryKey::encode_for_display() in crates/core/src/recovery_key.rs). 16 groups × 16 bits = exactly 256 bits.
